      Description copied from class: AColGroup

    • copyAndSet

      public final AColGroup copyAndSet(IDictionary newDictionary)
      This method copies the column group and sets the dictionary to another dictionary. The method shallow copies underlying data structures. NOTE: Be very carefull with this since it invalidate the contracts maintained via standard compression.
      Parameters:
      newDictionary - A new dictionary to point to.
      Returns:
      A new shallow copy of the column group

    • reduceCols

      public AColGroup reduceCols()
      Description copied from class: AColGroup
      Perform row sum on the internal dictionaries, and return the same index structure. This method returns null on empty column groups. Note this method does not guarantee correct behavior if the given group is AMorphingGroup, instead it should be morphed to a valid columngroup via extractCommon first.
      Specified by:
      reduceCols in class AColGroup
      Returns:
      The reduced colgroup.
